registry.champion_rationale: Cross-validation demonstrated that XGBoost (ROC-AUC 0.8487 ± 0.0110) and Random Forest (ROC-AUC 0.8470) are statistically comparable within 1 standard deviation margin. XGBoost was selected as production champion based on superior balance of recall, precision, and probability calibration.
leakage_controls: 80/20 stratified train/test split applied before any preprocessing
All scalers and encoders fit on training split only via Pipeline
Threshold optimization performed on cross-validation folds only
Final test set evaluated exactly once

fairness_audit.conclusion: Gender feature removal has negligible impact on model performance, confirming it is not a primary driver.

limitations: Dataset is a static cross-sectional snapshot with no timestamps — no true 30-day forward prediction
SHAP attributions reflect statistical associations, not causal relationships
Intervention cost assumptions are illustrative defaults requiring business calibration
No online learning or concept drift correction implemented yet
